In order to use Managed Apache Spark on Google Cloud, you need to enable the [Cloud Spark API](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/dataproc.googleapis.com). Consuming Google Cloud APIs may incur additional billing charges. You can learn more by clicking the above link.
[Enable API](command:google.datacloud.settings)
Alternatively, you can [switch projects](command:google.datacloud.settings.projectStatusBar.open) to a project that already has this API enabled.
